name: megascenes-coloring-page
description: Create printable coloring pages with clean black outlines on white, simple for kids or detailed for adults.

interface.longDescription:
Name a subject and who it is for and get a coloring page: clean black outlines on white, simple shapes for kids or intricate patterns for adults.

ChatGPT tells you what the run needs and creates the page in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The page opens in the chat and stays in your library, ready to print.

For parents, teachers and anyone who colors to relax.

Limitations: new pages from a description; it does not turn a photo you attach into a coloring page. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Simple for kids or detailed for adults
Return the page in the chat
defaultPrompt: A coloring page of a dinosaur having a picnic, simple for kids
A detailed mandala with flowers and birds for adults
A coloring page of a lighthouse by the sea, simple shapes

positive.prompt: A coloring page of a dinosaur having a picnic, simple for kids. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one coloring page needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A detailed mandala coloring page with flowers and birds, for adults. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one coloring page needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a coloring page here?
positive.expected_behavior: The coloring page models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A coloring page of a lighthouse by the sea with simple shapes, for kids. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my coloring page on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my coloring page to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: Name only: the brand suffix is gone from the plugin name. No change to the tools, the server or the listing text.
